Figure 1.Overview of our attribute-guided multi-genre expansion framework.
A thematic seed is transformed into diverse outputs by injecting curated genre attributes.Overview diagram showing how thematic seeds are transformed into genre-faithful outputs through curated genre attributes.

Figure 2.Attribute-guided genre expansion pipeline. We sample few-shot examples from existing story prompts to maintain thematic diversity, randomly sample subset genre-specific attributes to inject structural constraints, and generate multi-genre queries by combining task instructions, few-shot demonstrations, target genre, and sampled attributes.Pipeline diagram illustrating few-shot sampling, genre-attribute injection, and query generation for attribute-guided multi-genre data construction.
Figure 5.t-SNE visualization of the Multi-Genre Collection.t-SNE scatter plot showing semantic clusters for the 13 genres in the Multi-Genre Collection.
